project.name: OpenCOD: The Open Cause-of-Death Database
project.summary: A harmonised database of official mortality and population statistics launched as a pilot in Latin America and now open to countries worldwide, assembled from national statistical offices and ministries of health while preserving every source and methodological caveat. Fully reproducible code and data are available on GitHub; the database can be downloaded after registration.
